title: Signage & UI / Stage 5 artwork
summary: The approved set contains the ten Basement signs, Wet Floor and A Clean Start. Open a preview to inspect the artwork or download the editable SVG. [Download all 12 SVGs](sources/signage-stage5-svg.zip) · [Artwork and original PNGs](BASEMENT_SIGNAGE_STAGE5.md).

items.title: Stage 5 signage / Twelve editable designs
items.alt: Comparison of all twelve final Stage 5 sign and poster designs
items.body: [Download the SVG set](sources/signage-stage5-svg.zip) · [Original comparison sheet](media/basement-signs-stage5/basement-signs-overview.webp) · [Original Basement PNGs](sources/basement-signs-stage5.zip).

items.title: 01 / Employees Only
items.alt: Wide cream and bottle-green Employees Only plaque with the wizard and staff
items.body: The left-pointing wizard and slim divider leave the staff-access label as the main read. [Editable SVG](sources/signage-stage5-svg/01-employees-only.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/01-employees-only.png).

items.title: 02 / Restricted Area
items.alt: Square cream Restricted Area placard with charcoal text, an amber stripe, wizard and padlock
items.body: The amber stripe, padlock and approved left-pointing wizard identify a controlled door. [Editable SVG](sources/signage-stage5-svg/02-restricted-area.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/02-restricted-area.png).

items.title: 03 / Keep Out / Authorized Personnel Only
items.alt: Oxide-red and cream Keep Out sign with Authorized Personnel Only and a small pointing wizard
items.body: The oxide-red band emphasizes the prohibition, with the qualification and approved pointing wizard below. [Editable SVG](sources/signage-stage5-svg/03-keep-out.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/03-keep-out.png).

items.title: 04 / Cleaning Equipment
items.alt: Cream and green Cleaning Equipment sign with the approved wizard pushing a cleaning cart
items.body: The approved **Pushing equipment** pose replaces the proposal pictogram in the cream panel. [Editable SVG](sources/signage-stage5-svg/04-cleaning-equipment.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/04-cleaning-equipment.png).

items.title: 05 / Chemical Spill / Keep Clear
items.alt: Yellow Chemical Spill sign showing the approved wizard stepping in acid, with a black Keep Clear footer
items.body: The approved **Acid on the floor** pose shows the wizard stepping in the spill. The black Keep Clear footer stays prominent. [Editable SVG](sources/signage-stage5-svg/05-chemical-spill.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/05-chemical-spill.png).

items.title: 06 / Service Stairs
items.alt: Long cream Service Stairs sign with a downward arrow and the mascot carrying supplies
items.body: The approved Carrying supplies pose stays in the left panel and the arrow carries the downward direction. [Editable SVG](sources/signage-stage5-svg/06-service-stairs.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/06-service-stairs.png).

items.title: 07 / Return Tools / After Use
items.alt: Square Return Tools After Use notice with a cream mopping wizard in a green pictogram field
items.body: The approved Mopping pose anchors the dark green field against the stacked instruction. [Editable SVG](sources/signage-stage5-svg/07-return-tools.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/07-return-tools.png).

items.title: 08 / Danger / Toxic Vapors
items.alt: Safety-yellow Toxic Vapors sign with a pointed-ear goblin skull in a diamond
items.body: The traced goblin skull keeps the pointed ears and diamond frame of the selected vapor warning. [Editable SVG](sources/signage-stage5-svg/08-toxic-vapors-goblin.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/08-toxic-vapors-goblin.png).

items.title: 09 / Low Clearance / Watch Your Head
items.alt: Amber Low Clearance sign with a tusked orc ducking under an overhead beam
items.body: The traced orc, beam and downward chevrons retain the original low-clearance cue. [Editable SVG](sources/signage-stage5-svg/09-low-clearance-orc.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/09-low-clearance-orc.png).

items.title: 10 / Quiet Please / Test in Progress
items.alt: Cream Quiet Please sign with a pointed-ear elf and sound arcs above Test in Progress
items.body: The traced elf silhouette and listening arcs sit above the red divider and testing-room message. [Editable SVG](sources/signage-stage5-svg/10-quiet-testing-elf.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/10-quiet-testing-elf.png).

items.title: Hazard / Wet Floor
items.alt: Standalone black and yellow wet-floor sign with a slipping wizard
items.body: The original editable warning uses the approved **Slipping / falling** pose and a single diagonal stripe band. [Editable SVG](sources/signage-stage5-svg/wet-floor.svg) · [Original PNG](media/signage-ui-stage5-raster-review/wet-floor.png).

items.title: Corporate poster / A clean start
items.alt: 1970s poster with a greeting wizard, stepped green orange and mustard stripes, and bold dark green lettering
items.body: The approved Greeting pose sits inside the orange circle above the stepped stripes and editable two-line slogan. [Editable SVG](sources/signage-stage5-svg/clean-start-poster.svg) · [Original PNG](media/signage-ui-stage5-raster-review/clean-start-02.png).
